name: Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited
about: Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited engages in the provision of stockbroking services in India. The company offers retail broking services, including the purchase and sale of securities that comprise equity and derivative instruments; mutual fund distribution; and research services. The company was formerly known as Modern Home Credit & Capital Ltd. and changed its name to Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited in April 2002. Modern Shares and Stockbrokers Limited is based in Mumbai, India.
